title: 港珠澳大橋海底隧道~Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel
focus: 外海沉管、人工島與長期接頭變形~Open-sea immersion, artificial islands and long-term joint movement
summary: 香港政府工程頁把港珠澳主橋分為約23公里海上高架及約7公里隧道段，並說明外海沉管浮運落底的環境挑戰。本課集中隧道和人工島介面，循序分析箱體框架、浮力、基床、止水、測量及耐久；主橋、整體跨海計畫和沉管段的尺度各自保留原計量邊界。~The Hong Kong government separates the main crossing into about 23 km of viaduct and 7 km of tunnel and describes open-sea immersion challenges. This course focuses on tunnel-island interfaces through box-frame action, buoyancy, bedding, seals, surveying and durability. Main-crossing, whole-programme and immersed-section dimensions retain their distinct measurement boundaries.

units.anchor: 路線里程與端點~Alignment chainage and endpoints
units.title: 服務邊界與路線代價~Service boundaries and alignment cost
units.mechanism: 港珠澳的橋、隧道與口岸不是同一工程範圍，教材先確定隧道段端點再比較道路服務。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。~Bridge, tunnel and border facilities have different scope; define tunnel endpoints before comparing road service. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
units.model: 原創教學假設：長度=19.2 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=19.2 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為21.12 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: length=19.2 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=19.2 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 21.12 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 在數量表分開主橋、隧道與接線里程。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Separate main crossing, tunnel and approach lengths in the quantity register. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 把整體跨海長度當沉管長度會放大水下施工數量。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。~Using total crossing length as immersed length inflates underwater quantities. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison.
units.misconception: 最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。~The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
units.practice: 本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：在數量表分開主橋、隧道與接線里程。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。~For Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Separate main crossing, tunnel and approach lengths in the quantity register. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.

units.title: 矩形沉管的框架受力~Rectangular immersed-box frame action
units.mechanism: 港珠澳沉管是矩形多室箱體，教材研究中牆對頂板跨距的控制，禁止以圓環膜應力取代框架。矩形沉管的頂板、側牆與中牆透過框架連續性傳遞水土壓力，不能套圓形薄環的膜應力。單向簡支條帶只能估計局部彎矩量級；施工浮運、落底、回填和使用期的邊界不同，支承沉陷、接頭剪力及裂縫寬度仍須分階段檢核。~The immersed structure is a multicell rectangular box; examine how partitions control roof spans without substituting circular-ring membrane stress. A rectangular immersed tube transfers water and earth pressure through roof, walls and internal partitions acting as a frame. A circular thin-ring membrane formula is inappropriate. A simply supported strip estimates one bending scale only; flotation, placement, backfill and service change the restraints, requiring staged checks of settlement, joint shear and cracking.
units.model: 原創教學假設：單位長載重=38 kN/m；跨距=3.15 m。M=qL²/8=47.1319 kN·m。僅把跨距增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為57.0296 kN·m。邊界：均載簡支單向條帶，連續框架及板效應另驗；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: line load=38 kN/m; span=3.15 m. M=qL²/8=47.1319 kN·m. Increasing only span by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 57.0296 kN·m. Boundary: Uniformly loaded simply supported strip; frame continuity and plate action need separate checks. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 核對每個室的支承與荷載分配，再作局部條帶比較。比對頂板及中牆應變，使用含支承剛度的框架模型核對彎矩分配，將落底前後量測分開。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check support and load distribution for each cell before local strip comparison. Compare roof and partition strain with a frame model including support stiffness, keeping measurements before and after bedding separate. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 忽略內牆連續性可能錯估支點負彎矩與裂縫位置。忽略中牆支承或不均勻底床會錯估正負彎矩，局部裂縫可能是邊界變化而非材料強度不足。~Ignoring wall continuity misstates support hogging and crack location. Omitting partition support or uneven bedding misallocates positive and negative moments; local cracking may reflect changed restraints rather than weak material.
units.misconception: 矩形沉管可以直接使用圓環均勻外壓公式設計。~A rectangular immersed tube can be designed directly with a circular-ring pressure formula.
units.practice: 本案「頂板跨中彎矩」的交付需回答：核對每個室的支承與荷載分配，再作局部條帶比較。把單條帶、整體框架及接頭模型分開提交，標註適用施工階段和受力方向，保留裂縫及水密試驗的獨立判定。~For Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel, the roof-span bending handover must address the following evidence: Check support and load distribution for each cell before local strip comparison. Submit strip, whole-frame and joint models separately, identifying stage and load direction while retaining independent cracking and watertightness assessments.

units.title: 浮運重量帳與姿態穩定~Tow-out mass balance and stability
units.mechanism: 外海管節浮運需將重量、波浪和流場分開，教材的剩餘浮力只能說明靜態垂直力。浮力由排開水體重量決定，總質量還包含設備、臨時封端及艙內液體。重量帳只能判定淨垂直力，不能證明浮運穩定；壓載液自由表面、重心位置、拖纜與波浪都會改變傾斜反應，落底接觸亦需另建模型。~Open-sea towing needs separate mass, wave and current assessments; residual buoyancy describes only static vertical force. Buoyancy equals displaced water weight, while total mass includes equipment, temporary bulkheads and liquid contents. A mass balance determines net vertical force but does not establish towing stability. Ballast free surfaces, centre of gravity, tow lines and waves affect heel response, and initial contact with the bed needs another model.
units.model: 原創教學假設：水密度=1025 kg/m³；排水體積=13600 m³；總質量=1.35218e+07 kg。R=(ρV−m)g/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=4102.54 kN。僅把排水體積增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為17777.7 kN。邊界：靜水剩餘浮力，不驗證傾斜穩性及自由液面；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: water density=1025 kg/m³; displacement=13600 m³; mass=1.35218e+07 kg. R=(ρV−m)g/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=4102.54 kN. Increasing only displacement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 17777.7 kN. Boundary: Still-water buoyancy reserve, not heel stability or free-surface verification. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 以吃水、液艙水位及重量清冊互查，另列海況。以實際重量清冊和吃水測量互核，量測液艙水位及橫傾，檢查密度與體積是否採同一狀態。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Cross-check draught, tank levels and the mass register while recording sea state separately. Reconcile an itemised mass register with draught measurements, tank levels and heel, checking that density and displaced volume describe the same state. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 相同剩餘浮力的兩個壓載配置可能有不同傾斜穩性。漏列臨時設備或自由液面會使浮力帳看似足夠卻缺乏回正能力，偏載也可能先造成局部接觸。~Two ballast arrangements with equal residual buoyancy can have different heel stability. Missing temporary equipment or free-surface effects can leave an apparently adequate buoyancy balance with insufficient restoring capacity and premature local contact.
units.misconception: 剩餘浮力為正就代表浮運姿態在所有波況穩定。~Positive residual buoyancy establishes stability in every sea state.
units.practice: 本案「剩餘浮力」的交付需回答：以吃水、液艙水位及重量清冊互查，另列海況。質量清冊每次變更都重新確認重心和吃水，操作窗口依核准海事方案及量測決定，不由本課靜力式制定。~For Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel, the residual buoyancy handover must address the following evidence: Cross-check draught, tank levels and the mass register while recording sea state separately. Update centre of gravity and draught after every mass-register change; approved marine procedures and observations determine operating windows, not this static classroom equation.

units.anchor: 差異沉陷梯度~Differential settlement gradient
units.title: 基床變形與接頭轉角~Bedding movement and joint rotation
units.mechanism: 人工島附近與中央沉管的地層支承不同，教材追蹤差異固結對接頭轉角的影響。沉管基床將箱體荷載傳給海床，局部沖刷、回填不均與軟弱層固結會改變接觸分布。總沉陷小不代表接頭轉角小；相鄰管節的差異位移和支承長度才控制局部變形，施工量測須保留時間與潮位基準。~Island approaches and central tubes have different support conditions; trace differential consolidation into joint rotation. The bed transfers tube load into the seabed, and scour, uneven backfill or consolidation alter contact. Small total settlement does not imply small joint rotation; differential movement and support length control local distortion. Construction observations must preserve time and tidal datum because immediate placement and delayed consolidation describe different mechanisms.
units.model: 原創教學假設：差異沉陷=6 mm；基線長度=130 m。β=Δs/L=0.0461538 mm/m。僅把差異沉陷增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0507692 mm/m。邊界：小變形角變化指標，不是完整固結解；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: differential settlement=6 mm; baseline=130 m. β=Δs/L=0.0461538 mm/m. Increasing only differential settlement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0507692 mm/m. Boundary: Small-deformation angular-distortion indicator, not a consolidation solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 按管節編號對照沉陷、孔壓及回填時間。用管節水準網、海床剖面及孔壓變化交叉核對，將整體下沉與相鄰節轉角分開評估。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare settlement, pore pressure and backfill timing by element identifier. Cross-check tube levelling, seabed profiles and pore-pressure change, separating overall settlement from rotation between neighbouring elements. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 只核總沉陷可能漏掉島隧轉換處的局部折角。只追蹤平均高程可能漏掉單側失去支承，接頭剪力與止水錯台會先於明顯整體下沉增加。~Total settlement alone misses local angular distortion at island transitions. Mean elevation can conceal loss of support on one side, allowing joint shear and gasket offset to grow before obvious overall settlement.
units.misconception: 各管節平均高程接近就能排除接頭差異變形。~Similar mean element elevations exclude differential movement at joints.
units.practice: 本案「差異沉陷梯度」的交付需回答：按管節編號對照沉陷、孔壓及回填時間。將基床施工紀錄與長期水準資料連結至管節編號，差異變形先查基準和孔壓，再由設計者判斷接觸及接頭。~For Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel, the differential settlement gradient handover must address the following evidence: Compare settlement, pore pressure and backfill timing by element identifier. Link bedding records and long-term levelling to element identifiers; check datum and pore pressure before designers interpret contact and joint behaviour.

units.anchor: 止水壓縮餘量~Gasket compression reserve
units.title: 接頭壓縮與水密包絡~Joint compression and sealing envelope
units.mechanism: 長管列的接頭壓縮與閉合段幾何相互限制，教材分開局部水密包絡與全線累積誤差。止水條依受控壓縮維持連續接觸，接縫轉角、錯台、污染與材料鬆弛都會降低最不利點的接觸能力。平均壓縮量不能掩蓋局部脫離；全尺寸試驗的結果只對測試過的幾何、水壓及荷載歷程有效，幾何餘量本身並不是接觸壓力。~Joint compression and closure geometry interact across the long element chain; separate local seal envelopes from accumulated alignment error. A gasket seals through controlled continuous compression; rotation, offset, contamination and relaxation reduce contact at the weakest point. Average compression cannot compensate for local separation. Full-size test results apply only to their tested geometry, head and load history, while a calculated geometric reserve is neither contact pressure nor evidence of watertightness.
units.model: 原創教學假設：初始壓縮=20 mm；張開量=3.8 mm；幾何公差=2 mm。c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=14.2 mm。僅把張開量增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為13.82 mm。邊界：單向幾何餘量，不是接觸壓或水密合格證明；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: initial compression=20 mm; opening=3.8 mm; tolerance=2 mm. c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=14.2 mm. Increasing only opening by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 13.82 mm. Boundary: One-direction geometric reserve, not contact pressure or proof of watertightness. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 各接頭記錄張開、錯台與水壓，閉合段再核總幾何。全尺寸接頭試驗分別改變張開、錯台與外水壓，記錄漏水起點與卸載後殘餘位移，對照材料批次及溫度。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Record opening, offset and pressure at each joint and separately check closure geometry. Vary opening, offset and pressure in full-size joint tests, recording leakage onset and residual movement against material batch and temperature. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 全線貫通不證明每個接頭都在水密試驗包絡內。扭曲或沾污的止水條可形成旁通通道，即使平均縫寬合格仍可能漏水；盲目灌漿也可能只轉移出水位置。~Geometric closure does not prove every joint lies within the tested seal envelope. A twisted or contaminated gasket creates bypass leakage despite acceptable mean width; indiscriminate grouting may merely move the outlet.
units.misconception: 接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。~An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary.
units.practice: 本案「止水壓縮餘量」的交付需回答：各接頭記錄張開、錯台與水壓，閉合段再核總幾何。保存接縫幾何與試驗壓力的配對紀錄，由設計者核定允收包絡；驗收時不能把課堂的幾何餘量當產品認證數字。~For Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel, the gasket compression reserve handover must address the following evidence: Record opening, offset and pressure at each joint and separately check closure geometry. Retain paired joint geometry and test pressure, with the designer approving the acceptance envelope; classroom geometric reserves are not product certification values.

units.title: 控制網與貫通誤差~Control network and breakthrough error
units.mechanism: 海上沉放量測須處理潮位、姿態和控制網版本，教材研究偏差如何沿管列累積。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。~Immersion surveying must handle tide, attitude and control revisions; examine accumulated bias along the element chain. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control. A small closure does not exclude systematic bias: scale, refraction, orientation and vertical datum may shift together. Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations.
units.model: 原創教學假設：控制長度=5160 m；方向偏角=2.5 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.062541 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0687951 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: control length=5160 m; orientation error=2.5 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.062541 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0687951 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 以獨立岸基觀測覆核定位及落底後高程。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Independently check positioning and post-placement elevation from shore control. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 多次觀測若共用錯誤潮位基準，不會自行消除高程偏差。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。~Repeated observations sharing a wrong tidal datum do not remove elevation bias. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct.
units.misconception: 兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。~Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
units.practice: 本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：以獨立岸基觀測覆核定位及落底後高程。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。~For Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Independently check positioning and post-placement elevation from shore control. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.

units.anchor: 拘束溫度應變~Restrained thermal strain
units.title: 溫度拘束與構件裂縫~Thermal restraint and component cracking
units.mechanism: 大型預製箱體受早期水化熱與後續降溫，教材把熱應力量級和裂縫水密要求分開。厚壁構件在水化升溫後冷卻，若相鄰構件或基座限制收縮，熱應變會轉為拉應力。抗壓強度達標不等於抗裂合格，因為彈性模數成熟、徐變、溫度梯度與澆置順序都影響實際拘束；完全拘束彈性估算只能當量級上限比較。~Large precast boxes experience hydration heat and later cooling; distinguish thermal-stress scale from crack-watertightness requirements. A thick element cools after hydration, and restraint from adjacent pours or its base converts contraction into tension. Compressive-strength compliance does not establish crack resistance because modulus development, creep, gradients and pour sequence influence restraint. A fully restrained elastic estimate is therefore a scale bound, not a prediction of actual cracking or residual stress.
units.model: 原創教學假設：線膨脹係數=1e-05 K⁻¹；溫差=28 K；彈性模數=25 GPa。σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=7 MPa。僅把溫差增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為7.7 MPa。邊界：完全拘束線彈性量級，未含徐變開裂和拘束鬆弛；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: expansion coefficient=1e-05 K⁻¹; temperature difference=28 K; elastic modulus=25 GPa. σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=7 MPa. Increasing only temperature difference by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 7.7 MPa. Boundary: Fully restrained linear-elastic scale without creep, cracking or restraint relaxation. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 比較厚壁內外溫差及拘束位置的裂縫分布。記錄核心表面溫度及同條件試體成熟度，將裂縫位置與溫差、拆模及鄰段澆置時間配對，檢查熱歷程是否被遺漏。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare through-wall gradients with cracking near restraints. Record core/surface temperature and matched-cured maturity, pairing cracks with temperature differences, formwork removal and adjacent pours to identify missing thermal history. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 單一平均溫度無法代表厚壁熱梯度引起的局部應力。標準養護試體合格而現場過早冷卻，仍可能形成貫穿裂縫並影響止水；僅增加後續抗壓試驗無法重建失去的養護。~One average temperature does not represent local stress from thick-wall gradients. Passing standard-cured specimens does not prevent through-cracking after rapid cooling, and more later strength tests cannot reconstruct inadequate curing.
units.misconception: 混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。~Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks.
units.practice: 本案「拘束溫度應變」的交付需回答：比較厚壁內外溫差及拘束位置的裂縫分布。澆置前核准溫度監測及養護方案，變更材料、拆模或澆置順序時重新檢查熱分析，將裂縫與接縫止水的責任一併交付。~For Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel, the restrained thermal strain handover must address the following evidence: Compare through-wall gradients with cracking near restraints. Approve monitoring and curing before pours, revisit thermal analysis after material or sequence changes, and hand over crack and waterstop responsibilities together.

units.anchor: 擴散特徵長度~Diffusion characteristic length
units.title: 氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀~Chloride transport and durability interpretation
units.mechanism: 外海鹽水環境下箱體表面與接頭傳輸不同，教材將擴散特徵長度和鋼筋腐蝕啟動分開。海水或除冰鹽可提供氯離子，材料孔隙與裂縫控制其傳輸；鋼筋腐蝕還需要局部電化學條件。平方根擴散長度僅顯示時間尺度，並不是腐蝕門檻深度；表面濃度變化、乾濕循環、結合效應及施工裂縫須另行辨識。~Box surfaces and joints transport chloride differently; distinguish characteristic diffusion length from reinforcement corrosion initiation. Seawater or deicing salt supplies chloride, while pores and cracks govern transport; reinforcement corrosion also depends on local electrochemical conditions. A square-root diffusion length indicates a time scale, not a corrosion-threshold depth. Surface concentration, wetting cycles, binding and construction cracks must be distinguished rather than hidden in one fitted diffusivity.
units.model: 原創教學假設：擴散係數=3e-12 m²/s；暴露時間=17 year。ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=40.1178 mm。僅把暴露時間增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為42.0759 mm。邊界：特徵長度，不是腐蝕起始壽命或氯鹽門檻深度；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: diffusivity=3e-12 m²/s; exposure=17 year. ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=40.1178 mm. Increasing only exposure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 42.0759 mm. Boundary: Characteristic length, not corrosion-initiation life or chloride-threshold depth. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 按裂縫與未裂區分層取樣，不把接縫水當材料係數。以分層取樣的氯鹽剖面配合裂縫圖與電位量測，檢查擴散模型是否只適用未開裂材料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Sample cracked and uncracked zones separately rather than fitting joint water into a material coefficient. Combine depth-resolved chloride samples with crack maps and potential measurements, checking whether the diffusion model applies only to uncracked material. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 高滲透接頭可能控制局部病害，平均擴散值會掩蓋它。把一次電位讀值當腐蝕速率會誤判剩餘壽命，裂縫快速傳輸也可能被平均材料係數掩蓋。~A permeable joint can govern local deterioration concealed by mean diffusivity. Treating one potential reading as corrosion rate misjudges remaining life, while averaged material coefficients conceal rapid crack transport.
units.misconception: 擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。~Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation.
units.practice: 本案「擴散特徵長度」的交付需回答：按裂縫與未裂區分層取樣，不把接縫水當材料係數。保留取樣深度、含水狀態及材料批次，用多種證據解釋劣化；維修優先序依構件功能與實際病害制定。~For Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel, the diffusion characteristic length handover must address the following evidence: Sample cracked and uncracked zones separately rather than fitting joint water into a material coefficient. Retain sample depth, moisture and material batches and interpret deterioration using multiple evidence types; prioritise repairs by function and observed defects.

units.anchor: 風道摩擦壓損~Duct friction loss
units.title: 通風網路與壓力損失~Ventilation network and pressure loss
units.mechanism: 隧道與人工島通風設施互為邊界，教材研究島上外風與孔內車流對工況點的聯合作用。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。~Island ventilation facilities and the tunnel share boundaries; examine external wind and traffic effects on operating points. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans. Switching a branch redistributes the network rather than simply adding rated flows. Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target.
units.model: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1220 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.8 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=66.063 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為79.9362 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1220 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.8 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=66.063 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 79.9362 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 同步量測外風、風機狀態、風道壓差及道路風速。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Synchronise wind, fan state, duct pressure and roadway velocity. Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 額定風量不含島上風壓變化，不能直接代表實際換氣。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。~Rated flow excludes varying island wind pressure and is not actual ventilation. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air.
units.misconception: 風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。~Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
units.practice: 本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：同步量測外風、風機狀態、風道壓差及道路風速。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。~For Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel, the duct friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Synchronise wind, fan state, duct pressure and roadway velocity. Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.

units.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接~Asset identity and traceable handover
units.mechanism: 管節量產與多區施工的資料須對應最終安裝位置，教材檢查材料批次、接頭和檢修點的關聯。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。~Production and multiple work zones need records tied to final installation, linking batches, joints and inspection points. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
units.model: 原創教學假設：設備總數=118 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.4407 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為85.0847 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: asset count=118 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.4407 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 85.0847 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 由一個漏點反查管節編號、試驗和接頭施工紀錄。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Trace one leak to element identity, tests and joint-construction records. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 編號沿用工廠順序而未改安裝序會錯配維修證據。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。~Keeping factory order instead of installed order mislinks repair evidence. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.
units.misconception: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。~Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
units.practice: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：由一個漏點反查管節編號、試驗和接頭施工紀錄。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。~For Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Trace one leak to element identity, tests and joint-construction records. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

example: 原創綜合審查：先計算「矩形沉管的框架受力」，再獨立計算「控制網與貫通誤差」。原創教學假設：單位長載重=38 kN/m；跨距=3.15 m。M=qL²/8=47.1319 kN·m。僅把跨距增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為57.0296 kN·m。邊界：均載簡支單向條帶，連續框架及板效應另驗；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：控制長度=5160 m；方向偏角=2.5 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.062541 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0687951 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。~Original integrated review: first calculate rectangular immersed-box frame action, then independently calculate control network and breakthrough error. Original teaching assumptions: line load=38 kN/m; span=3.15 m. M=qL²/8=47.1319 kN·m. Increasing only span by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 57.0296 kN·m. Boundary: Uniformly loaded simply supported strip; frame continuity and plate action need separate checks. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: control length=5160 m; orientation error=2.5 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.062541 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0687951 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
history: 2018 年公開記錄：港珠澳大橋跨海交通工程開始服務。香港政府工程頁把港珠澳主橋分為約23公里海上高架及約7公里隧道段，並說明外海沉管浮運落底的環境挑戰。本課集中隧道和人工島介面，循序分析箱體框架、浮力、基床、止水、測量及耐久；主橋、整體跨海計畫和沉管段的尺度各自保留原計量邊界。本課把「外海沉管、人工島與長期接頭變形」視為互相連動的系統，工程年代和名稱由所列公開來源核對；模型中的設備配置、荷載與量測數字另外標明為教學假設，只重建公開原理及工程推理，不是原始設計文件。~Public record for 2018: The Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao crossing enters service. The Hong Kong government separates the main crossing into about 23 km of viaduct and 7 km of tunnel and describes open-sea immersion challenges. This course focuses on tunnel-island interfaces through box-frame action, buoyancy, bedding, seals, surveying and durability. Main-crossing, whole-programme and immersed-section dimensions retain their distinct measurement boundaries. The course treats open-sea immersion, artificial islands and long-term joint movement as coupled engineering questions. Named events and dimensions follow the listed public sources; equipment scenarios, loads and measurement values are separately marked teaching assumptions. Only public principles and reasoning are reconstructed, not original design documents.
facts: 公開工程尺度約為 approximately 7 km tunnel section，保留所列來源的計量邊界。~The public scale is about approximately 7 km tunnel section; retain the measurement boundary in the cited source.
2018 年事件：港珠澳大橋跨海交通工程開始服務。~2018 event: The Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao crossing enters service.

教學「路線里程與端點」：長度=19.2 km，其餘輸入依單元，結果=19.2 min；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching alignment chainage and endpoints: length=19.2 km, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 19.2 min; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「頂板跨中彎矩」：單位長載重=38 kN/m，其餘輸入依單元，結果=47.1319 kN·m；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching roof-span bending: line load=38 kN/m, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 47.1319 kN·m; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「止水壓縮餘量」：初始壓縮=20 mm，其餘輸入依單元，結果=14.2 mm；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching gasket compression reserve: initial compression=20 mm, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 14.2 mm; not measured or accepted project data.
教學「方向角誤差」：控制長度=5160 m，其餘輸入依單元，結果=0.062541 m；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching orientation error: control length=5160 m, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 0.062541 m; not measured or accepted project data.
